title: 漫威电影查询
problem_statement_md:
假设有一张电影表**films**，其中每部电影的详细信息：

![](/content/assets/066bfb0727e2f50ef761.jpeg)

其中列字段含义为：
- `name`: 电影名
- `genre`: 电影风格
- `year`: 发行年
- `production`: 制片方


请编写一个查询，输出制片方**Marvel Studios**在2010年或以后制作的所有电影的名称，并按名称排序。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following [b]films[/b] table with details about superhero movies: [img id="4514" width="100%"]
Write a query to output the [b]names[/b] of all of the films which were produced by Marvel Studios in 2010 or later, sorted by the 'name' column.
[note]Use the [b]AND[/b] operator to combine two or more conditions.[/note]
hint_md: 使用**AND**操作符来组合两个或多个条件。

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT name 
FROM films 
WHERE production = 'Marvel Studios' AND year >= 2010 
ORDER BY name
code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE films (
  name VARCHAR(128),
  genre VARCHAR(128),
  year int,
  production VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO films (name,genre,year,production)
VALUES
('Iron Man','Superheroes',2008,'Marvel Studios'),
('Venom','Superheroes',2018,'Columbia Pictures'),
('The Dark Knight','Superheroes',2008,'Warner Brothers'),
('The Avengers','Superheroes',2012,'Marvel Studios'),
('Avengers:Endgame','Superheroes',2019,'Marvel Studios');
